_note: Traps (SPD levels/traps/*.java). sprite = index into assets/tiles/terrain_features.png (color + shape*16). Mobs know where traps are and avoid them, but knockback can push them in.

gripping.name: Gripping Trap
gripping.desc: Snaps shut: 2 damage and the victim loses its next turn.

teleport.name: Teleportation Trap
teleport.desc: Teleports the victim to the far side of the room.

poison_dart.name: Poison Dart Trap
poison_dart.desc: Poison: 1 damage now and 1 per turn for 4 turns (ignores DR and Barrier).
